project.name: PyCubed v0.5 TestStand Emulator
project.purpose: Software-only automated manufacturing test architecture for PyCubed v0.5 before NI TestStand implementation

operator_traceability.method: Scan badge or enter operator ID

station_verification.maintenance_or_suspected_station_fault: Reboot station; next DUT requires Golden Reference
station_verification.on_reference_fail: Block DUT testing and go to Cleanup

capabilities: Manual rotating fixture with fixed 0° and 45° positions

test_sequence.name: Safe Power-Up / Overcurrent
actions: Set VBATT and safety current limit
test_sequence.on_fail: Immediate power OFF, DUT FAIL, skip dependent tests, Cleanup
test_sequence.note: Current values are simulation/examples, not official PyCubed production limits.

test_sequence.name: 3.3 V Rail Verification
test_sequence.measurement: Fixture DMM/DAQ measures 3.3 V rail to GND
test_sequence.on_fail: DUT FAIL, skip programming/functional tests, power OFF, Cleanup
test_sequence.note: 3.20–3.40 V is a project/simulation range, not an official PyCubed production limit.

test_sequence.name: Internal Flash / Software Verification
actions: Compare with latest manufacturer-provided version approved for the station
Compare with latest manufacturer-provided version approved for the station
If missing/outdated, program approved package and verify again
Reset DUT and verify firmware handshake

test_sequence.name: BMX160 IMU Functional Test
actions: Initialize IMU and confirm device ID
Prompt operator to rotate fixture to 45°
During rotation verify expected gyro axis changes
After stop verify gyro returns near stationary

test_sequence.name: ADM1176 Multi-Point Current Measurement
procedure: Adjust electronic load until independent fixture measurement reaches target TOTAL current
Take several ADM1176 readings after stabilization
Average readings
Compare ADM1176 current to independently measured fixture current
Calculate percentage error
important: 125/250/500 mA are total current through R8, not electronic-load setpoints
Final production limits must include ADM1176 accuracy, R8 tolerance, and fixture measurement uncertainty

test_sequence.name: External Watchdog Recovery Test
test_sequence.purpose: Verify that loss of the MCU watchdog heartbeat causes the expected hardware watchdog event and that the DUT recovers.

reset_time_delay_ms.usage: Diagnostic/reference timing; not used as the primary watchdog timeout PASS/FAIL criterion.

procedure: Confirm DUT firmware is running and communication is active.
Confirm watchdog heartbeat is active.
Record the pre-test boot/reset state if available.
Command the test firmware to stop toggling the watchdog input.
Start an independent fixture/TestStand timer.
Detect the watchdog event / MCU reset independently of the DUT command path.
Measure elapsed time from heartbeat stop to watchdog-triggered reset.
Wait for DUT reboot.
Re-establish communication with the DUT.
Confirm the boot/reset state changed if a reset counter or reset-cause register is available.

pass_if: Measured watchdog timeout is between 1.00 s and 2.25 s.
DUT reboots and communication is restored.
fail_if: Watchdog event occurs before 1.00 s or after 2.25 s.
DUT does not recover communication after reset.

notes: 1.6 s is the typical timeout; the datasheet acceptance window is 1.00–2.25 s.
The ~200 ms reset delay is a separate supervisory timing parameter and should not be confused with the watchdog timeout.
Final board-level implementation must confirm the exact MAX706 variant and how its watchdog output is wired into the PyCubed reset path.

test_sequence.name: USB Data & USB Power Test
test_sequence.purpose: Verify both USB data communication and operation of the board from USB power.

subtests.name: USB Data Communication

power_configuration.usb_power_path: Disabled or isolated during this subtest where fixture design permits

procedure: Power DUT from fixture VBATT.
Connect USB data path.
Verify USB enumeration on the station PC.
Verify expected USB device/interface identity.
Open the communication interface.
Send TEST_PING.
Verify TEST_PONG.
Send a known data block.
Read/echo the returned block.
Compare byte-for-byte.

retest.reason: One reconnect/re-enumeration retry is allowed for a transient issue.

subtests.name: USB Power Operation

power_configuration.usb_charging_path: Handled separately in the charger test block

procedure: Turn fixture VBATT source OFF.
Enable the board USB power path/jumper configuration.
Connect USB-C power/data.
Verify the board powers up from USB.
Measure the 3.3 V rail.
Verify USB enumeration.
Send TEST_PING and verify TEST_PONG.
Perform a small data-transfer/loopback check.
pass_if: Board powers from USB with fixture VBATT OFF.
3.3 V rail is within the project-approved test limit.
USB command/response and data transfer succeed.
subtests.on_fail: Mark USB Power subtest FAIL and return all power paths to a safe state.

safety_and_design_notes: The fixture must control VBATT and USB power paths to avoid unintended back-powering.
USB board-power verification and USB battery charging are different tests.
Exact jumper/switch implementation will be finalized with the physical fixture design.

test_sequence.name: ADM1176 VBATT Voltage Measurement
test_sequence.purpose: Verify that the ADM1176 voltage measurement tracks the actual VBATT voltage at nominal and fully charged 2S battery conditions.

test_points.rationale: Nominal 2S Li-Ion operating point used by this project.
Upper fully charged 2S Li-Ion point / PyCubed charger float-voltage condition.

procedure: Set fixture VBATT source to the target voltage.
Measure the actual VBATT voltage with the independent fixture DMM/DAQ.
Command/read the ADM1176 voltage conversion.
Convert the ADM1176 ADC code to voltage.
Compare ADM1176 measured voltage to the actual fixture DMM/DAQ voltage.
Calculate absolute voltage error and percentage error.
Repeat for both 7.4 V and 8.4 V test points.

project_limit.note: This is a temporary project/simulation PASS/FAIL limit, not an official PyCubed manufacturing limit.

pass_fail_logic.pass_if: Absolute percentage error is <= 5.0% at both test points.
pass_fail_logic.fail_if: Absolute percentage error is > 5.0% at either test point.

notes: The PASS/FAIL comparison uses actual fixture DMM/DAQ voltage, not only the programmed supply setpoint.
The 7.4 V point represents the nominal project operating point.
The 8.4 V point represents the fully charged 2S Li-Ion / charger float-voltage condition.
Final production limits should include ADM1176 behavior in the board operating range plus fixture/DMM uncertainty.

test_sequence.name: ADM1176 Overcurrent Protection / Auto-Retry
test_sequence.purpose: Verify overcurrent protection, automatic retry, and recovery after the overload condition is removed.
procedure: Power DUT from fixture VBATT at 7.4 V.
Apply 0.5 A normal load and verify stable operation.
Apply a 1.2 A overload request.
Verify the ADM1176 enters current-limit/protection behavior and does not sustain 1.2 A.
Verify the protected power path switches off while the overload persists.
Verify the ADM1176-1 performs an automatic retry.
Remove the overload and return to the normal load condition.
Verify power, 3.3 V rail, and DUT communication recover.

pass_if: 0.5 A normal load remains stable without a protection event.
1.2 A overload request causes protection behavior rather than sustained 1.2 A delivery.
Protected output switches off while overload persists.
fail_if: Protection triggers during the 0.5 A normal condition.
1.2 A remains sustained without a protection response.
Protected output does not switch off.
DUT does not recover after overload removal.

notes: The 1.2 A point is intentionally above the approximately 1.0 A nominal current-limit level for R8 = 0.1 ohm.
Exact timing is logged only as diagnostic information for now and is not a PASS/FAIL criterion.
Final hardware limits must include resistor tolerance and fixture measurement uncertainty.

actions: Return electronic load to safe state

sources.name: Analog Devices MAX706P/R/S/T datasheet
